set.body:
DomainFactory now holds a process-wide DomainRegistry so one SpaceKey names one live owner. That is correct, but it makes key size and key cardinality a retention concern, because several keys embed their content verbatim:

- threshold/MaskedField.scala:177  "${id}:threshold-active:${volumeIndex.mkString(",")}"
- latent/RadialSelection.scala:226 "scalafim:latent:radial-active:${activeToFullGrid.mkString(",")}"
- dataset/DatasetAcquisitionDomain.scala:150 "${key}:active:${requestedVoxelDomain.indices.mkString(",")}"
- atlas/AtlasQuotient.scala:93 parcels key embeds every region id (bounded, hundreds)

locus4s places no length bound on DomainId/DomainName (parse only rejects empty), so these are accepted. For a 200k-voxel mask, indices averaging ~6 digits plus separators is roughly a 1.4 MB key string (arithmetic, not measured). DomainFactory passes name = key.value, and DomainId is an opaque String, so name and id share one instance — about one large string retained per distinct derived domain, permanently, plus the O(n) allocation to build it on every construction.

Before canonicalization these were transient. Now every distinct mask or searchlight support adds a permanent registry entry. A long-running process doing per-subject searchlight work accumulates them.

Two candidate fixes, not yet chosen:

1. Hash the content into the key (stable digest of the index array) instead of embedding it. Keeps canonicalization correct — same content still yields the same key — and makes keys O(1).
2. Use FiniteDomain.ephemeral for these. locus4s documents ephemeral domains as 'appropriate for selection-position domains and other derived in-memory structures', which is exactly what an active-voxel or searchlight-support domain is. They then carry no persistent record, are not registry-retained, and cannot be serialized as spaces — which is likely fine for derived supports but needs checking against the archive paths.

Option 2 is probably the right model and 1 is the cheap mitigation; they are not exclusive.

Context: the canonicalization change is in modules/locus-data/.../DomainFactory.scala, pinned by DomainIdentityProbeSuite.
set.title: Content-embedded SpaceKeys now retained forever by the canonical registry
